GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced three wide without cover for the majority of the event. Rider reported that he intended on leading the race but despite being ridden along in the early stages the gelding did not muster speed and as a result settled further back than intended, in a midfield position. He added the gelding raced flat and had to be continually pressured through the early and middles stages which had a detrimental effect to the geldings' finishing efforts. A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities.
